'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Bill Kafer LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Bill Kafer]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Bill Kafer]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
